s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

differentials: hyalinizing trabecular tumor of the thyroid gland

shortlist.label: cutaneous cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans

shortlist.label: cutaneous histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: similar presentation with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection

shortlist.label: mycetoma
shortlist.why_kept: subacute tender nodule with granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: granulomatous inflammation on skin biopsy and subacute presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and the growth of Cryptococcus neoformans in tissue culture are consistent with cutaneous cryptococcosis, especially in an immunocompromised patient on fingolimod for multiple sclerosis.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Lack of systemic symptoms and absence of non-caseating granulomas without yeast

rejected.label: cutaneous histoplasmosis
rejected.why: No evidence of exposure to bird or bat droppings and negative serum and tissue tests for Histoplasma

rejected.label: mycetoma
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology do not match the characteristic features of mycetoma, such as draining sinuses and presence of grains

rejected.label: tuberculosis
rejected.why: No evidence of tuberculosis infection, such as positive blood cultures or cerebrospinal fluid tests, and skin biopsy does not show caseating granulomas
